unit: Anne Shirley was born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia, to schoolteacher parents who both died of fever shortly after her birth. Raised in hardship by various foster families and an orphan asylum, she was mistakenly brought to Green Gables in Avonlea, Prince Edward Island, by Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert, who had wanted a boy. Despite the mistake, they decided to keep her. Anne quickly formed a passionate, lifelong friendship with her neighbor Diana Barry. She attended Avonlea school, where an academic rivalry with Gilbert Blythe began after he called her 'Carrots' and she smashed her slate over his head. Anne excelled in her studies, eventually tying with Gilbert for first place on the Island-wide entrance exams for Queen's Academy. After a year at Queen's, she won the Avery Scholarship, but gave up going to college to stay at Green Gables and teach at Avonlea when Matthew died and Marilla's eyesight threatened to fail. During her two years as a beloved Avonlea schoolma'am, Anne organized the Avonlea Village Improvement Society, helped raise the orphaned Keith twins at Green Gables, and formed a deep friendship with the romantic Miss Lavendar Lewis. When Marilla's friend Mrs. Rachel Lynde came to live at Green Gables, Anne was able to resume her studies and attended Redmond College in Kingsport alongside Gilbert, Priscilla Grant, and new friend Philippa Gordon. At Redmond, Anne was courted by the wealthy, handsome Roy Gardner, but eventually realized he was not her true ideal and rejected his proposal. Returning home after graduating with High Honors in English, Anne suffered through a night of anguish when Gilbert fell dangerously ill with typhoid fever, realizing then that she loved him.
